entities.name: Library of Alexandria

entities.summary: The greatest library of the ancient world (c. 295 BCE – 48 BCE), housing hundreds of thousands of scrolls in Alexandria, Egypt. It was the center of Hellenistic scholarship and the model for all subsequent libraries and universities.
